title: BusyBox variables
description: Configuration variables for BusyBox across POSIX, Windows native (MSVC), and MS-DOS.

BUSYBOX_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install BusyBox. 'libscript_native' installs isolated prebuilt binaries (SamuelMarks/busybox-windows on Windows/MS-DOS, static musl on Linux), 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

BUSYBOX_VERSION.description: Specific version of busybox to install (e.g., 1.39.0 on Windows or latest).

BUSYBOX_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading busybox binary or archive artifacts.

BUSYBOX_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying busybox available remote releases.
